Donation terms

Giving, clearly explained.

Current status

Online checkout is not connected. Selecting an amount or reviewing a gift does not transfer money or create a monthly donation.

Tax status

The Tree of LIF Ltd is an Arizona nonprofit corporation. We have not yet received IRS tax-exempt status, so gifts are not tax-deductible at this time.

Gift choices

You can choose one-time or monthly support, directed to Arizona, Benin, or where it is needed most. Suggested amounts are examples. Specific costs and how designated gifts are allocated are being confirmed.

Before online giving opens

The team will publish how receipts are sent, how to request a refund, how to cancel a monthly gift, and how designated funds are used, before checkout is turned on.

Talk to us

Call +1 (402) 870-8800 to discuss a gift with the team.
